messages.subject: [STATSGRASS] Migration to new mailing list system done
messages.subject_clean: [STATSGRASS] Migration to new mailing list system done
messages.body_plain:
Dear subscribers,

due to the continuous spamming problems I have migrated this list to
"mailman" system. In opposite to the former "minordomo" it needs an
additional acknowledge-step to subscribe which shall prevent spam mails.

If you have received this mail, your existing subscription was already
migrated correctly. However, there is one step to be done: You will want to
know your "statsgrass" subscription password which was auto-generated today:

To receive the password,

1. Enter the new "statsgrass" list page:
   http://www.geog.uni-hannover.de/mailman/listinfo/statsgrass

2. At bottom of page, there is a button "Edit Options". Left to that enter
   your email adress and hit the "Edit Options" button.

3. A new page appears where you will hit the button
     "Email My Password To Me"

After receiving your current password you can, if desired, customize your
"statsgrass" subscription on this page and/or change your password.

In case of problems, please let me know.

Regards

 Markus Neteler

--

Schneiderberg 50 * D-30167 Hannover * Germany
